headline: Celtics hit Philly as Patriots suffer gut-wrenching Rhamondre Stevenson injury
morning_brew: The C's are rolling into Philadelphia for a massive Tuesday night showdown against the 76ers. We're riding a three-game win streak, but going into the Xfinity Mobile Arena to face a team that sits right ahead of us in the standings is gonna be the real test of where this group is at. It's the first time Jaylen Brown is gonna suit up against the boys in green since the move, and you can bet the atmosphere in Philly is gonna be electric. I've been watching the ball movement all week, and if Jayson Tatum keeps finding his spots like he has during this run, we've got more than enough firepower to go in there and steal a win on the road.

The news out of Foxborough this morning is a total gut punch. Rhamondre Stevenson is expected to miss time with a knee tendon issue, which is the last thing this offense needed while we're trying to find some consistency in the back half of the season. He's been the engine for us on the ground, and seeing him go down is a massive blow to the game plan. The front office is gonna have to lean on the depth in the room, but let's be honest, replacing a back of his caliber is easier said than done. It feels like one step forward and two steps back every damn week with this squad.

It is a tough look for the Patriots, especially with the draft projections starting to pop up all over the place, but we've got a lot of football left to play. I will be watching the Celtics tonight through my fingers because these Philly matchups never fail to spike my blood pressure. No matter what happens on the court or the gridiron, it's never a dull moment being a fan in this town. Grab your Dunks and stay tuned, because this week is shaping up to be a real ride.

news_digest.headline: Source: Pats' Rhamondre Stevenson expected to miss time with knee tendon issue
news_digest.dans_take: Just our friggin' luck to lose the best back on the roster when the season is on the line.

news_digest.headline: As Jaylen Brown faces the Celtics for the first time, familiar questions linger
news_digest.dans_take: Seeing Brown in a Sixers jersey is gonna feel like a bad dream, but that is the business I suppose.
